question: What immediate power over the three worlds does meditation on her grant the practitioner?
premises: She is meditated upon by the practitioner.
Her power brings the three worlds under control.
inference: When meditated upon, she quickly makes the three worlds subject to the practitioner.
uncertainties: The token sādhakasyāśu appears alongside a separate āśu; the repetition may be emphatic.
plain_english: When meditated upon, she quickly brings the three worlds under the practitioner's control.
